unchanged: no sector cap, no regime filter, no factor combination
rebalance_order: 1 exit: outside hold zone -> full exit
2 trim: signal-basis weight > 7.5% -> sell to max(1, floor(5% NAV_signal / sizing price))
3 top-up: signal-basis weight < 2.5% and inside hold zone -> buy up to floor(5% NAV_signal / sizing price)
4 entry: empty slots from the top-10% zone in rank order (V2 rules incl. whole-share skip and the 2.5% cash-short stop)

5 cash allocation: holdings inside the top-10% zone whose signal-basis weight after steps 1-4 is < 5%, in rank order, one pass: buy floor((5% NAV_signal - current signal-basis value) / sizing price) shares, decremented while cash is short
6 no position exceeds the 5% target through step 5 (signal basis)
cash_allocation_scope: held names only (step 4 already offers every empty slot to the top-10% zone); N never exceeds 20; applies to BOTH books (one portfolio engine)
signal_basis: value = shares x signal close in execution-day share units; weight = value / NAV at the signal close (pre-trade)
